reviews.title: Fill in for Air Vanuatu
reviews.text: Air Vanuatu cancelled flight, was told to go to the airport at 2am, day before my scheduled flight out. an aircraft arrived from Nauru. Greeted at top of stairs to aircraft by a crew member, friendly and happy. Meal was a lovely chicken sandwich, mandarin, packet of chips and a timtam. Also was a cool cloth (in a packet) , to freshen up after lunch. There was alcohol available on the flight. (Too early for me). Crew gave service with a smile. It was a pleasure to be on this flight.
reviews.author: cardeb

reviews.title: Primitive but friendly
reviews.text: I booked on Air Vanuatu fur a recent holiday, but unfortunately for some reason they aren’t flying their own routes at the moment and care code sharing with Nauru Airlines. These planes are flying buses. There’s no other way to describe it. Good points: - great, friendly, efficient service - generous drink service - food (what little there was offered) wasn’t too bad at all - a tomatoey peri peri chicken over yellow pilau rice and peas, with a cookie. Negatives: - planes are old - no in-flight entertainment at all - planes poorly kept - my leg is cut and bruised after I caught it on a broken part of the seat. Luckily I had savlon and waterproof band aids in my case... - meal is absolutely tiny and drink selection is minimal We got there safely - and early, somehow, even though we left late. Would I pay to fly them? No, not unless I was needing a super budget option. BUT the staff do an incredible job with not very much to work with at all, and show great pride and training.
reviews.author: Trudi W

reviews.title: Nauru Airlines service
reviews.text: The food on this airline is the worst I have ever experienced. We were served breakfast. I selected the lemon pancakes, I was served 3 small round shapes that were not very edible and tasteless. Thank goodness there was a fruit yoghurt with my meal. The coffee was luke warm and only a half serve. The seat covers were dirty and did not leave a good impression. Shame on you Qantas as this is a code share and not up to your standards.
reviews.author: Kathryn Kiwi

reviews.title: A nice surprise
reviews.text: We had paid to fly with Air Vanuatu earlier in the day but were transferred to this flight. It was an old plane, which actually was OK. Lots of legroom and a nostalgic experience for me. No screens whatsoever, not even music to listen too. I loved my lacto ovo vegetarian meal which ended up being a cauliflower masala with a lamington. The main food looked yummy too, but none were especially big. There were plenty of opportunities for the drink trolley too. Service was lovely.
reviews.author: Katherine A

reviews.title: Vanuatu - Code Share - Qantas, Air Vanuatu, Nauru Airlines
reviews.text: Following onto my previous review for Qantas (prior to our travel) in which I was disappointed because we had booked our flights to Vanuatu to be Qantas, and was aware that they were code sharing with Air Vanuatu, but what we were not aware of was that the end carrier would be Nauru Airlines. I was rather wary at first but can report now was pleasantly surprised. Although the plane was a bit older with no TV it was very comfortable with more leg room than most planes. On the way there we sat in row 6, which was the first row behind business class and the gentleman next to us requested to be moved, so we had the 3 seats to share between the two of us and so was an extremely comfortable flight. Similarly on the flight back - we were in row 8 and had no-one sitting next to us. The food and wine was very good and the rest rooms were cleaner than on many other flights I have been on. Both flights arrived on time despite the return flight leaving 15 mins late. So in summary, it was a very pleasant flight and would not hesitate to fly with Nauru Airlines again.
reviews.author: Erika K

reviews.title: Best ever
reviews.text: Totally loved it. Customer service is great. Very understanding when it comes to traveling with kids. Meals and drinks offered is inclusive in the fare. Drinks and snacks offered before and after stop over as well. Definitely recommending it for parents flying with kids. Even for booking they are more flexible than others. I paid via ttf and extended my ticket due date for ease, replied to emails efficiently as well.
reviews.author: deomd13

reviews.title: Best service ever!
reviews.text: Plane was an older 737 but service was impeccable. After serving the meal, the very friendly staff they kept coming back offering more drinks etc haven't seen this level of service for decades. Made a very pleasant trip.
reviews.author: 647warrenp

reviews.title: booked Air Vanuatu got Air Nauru instead
reviews.text: What a lovely flight there and back, Spacious economy seats very clean and comfortable. The staff were friendly, Happy and helpful. The in-flight meals were better than most meals we have had in-flight and it was rather tasty. Dinner on the way there and breakfast on the way home The flight there was a little warmer than the flight home, we did have a little laugh that maybe they were getting us climatize to were we were heading.
reviews.author: Christodoulou2

reviews.title: Great people
reviews.text: So Nauru airlines, is not your normal Airline but be patient and you'll get there. Their best asset are their staff, when flights were delayed we got accommodation when flights were cancelled, they did all they could to help, we flew all over the central pacific over 5 weeks and the trip was wonderful. When a flight was altered even the cabin crew helped us out to get other flights as they were staying at the same accommodation. The on-board food is fine and plenty of legroom for the times flown. A big thankyou to Bluebird in Brisbane office who has the best customer service I have ever come across in an airline. Also Jamima one of the wonderful cabin crew who went the extra mile to help us. Thanks lee and Sara Martin
reviews.author: lee m

reviews.title: 13hours delay without notice
reviews.text: Flight got delayed by... 13 hours!! The notification of the changes came just 2 hours before the flight!! They didn’t want to pay for any hotel reservation lost, connecting flight loss, meals or anything, (basically you are captive in the island, so good luck in trying to demand your rights you are basically powerless) When complaining on the lack of support they lied about having sent emails that they never sent (I still wonder how they decide to lie on something so easy to prove) Take this airline at your own risk, and if you have any other flight connection to take.... well, good luck... The only reason I put score of two and not zero is because the plane is comfortable for Pacific standards, and flight crew are polite and helpful
reviews.author: avidtraveller777

reviews.title: Could have been 5 stars
reviews.text: Would have been perfect had they not decided to change my flight 1.5 months in advance from a day flight to a night flight (i.e. a 13 hour change). The airlines was besides this change punctual, offer food, drinks, has enough legroom. They even got my special mean from Nauru (Seafood). Their website also improves but I have the feeling the schedule is not up to date on that they should work.
reviews.author: none3

reviews.title: Professional Airline
reviews.text: I was worried about this airline since it is based in such a tiny country. However, it is very professional and they use a reasonably sized plane. We took several flights with them. One flight was unbelievably hot. On another, we arrived early to Majuro, which was wonderful, but we had to wait 30 minutes in the heat for immigration to arrive. It seems the airport staff could have some simple communication with the airline! In our experience, this airline had capable, professional, and kind employees. They were reliable and we felt safe.
reviews.author: JulieJewels4444

reviews.title: Pleasantly suprised
reviews.text: Was a bit hesitant when our Code share flight turned out to be Nauru Airlines but was pleasantly surprised by the experience. Yes the plane was a little older than normal but it had plenty of legroom was nice and clean and the staff were quite accomodating. Also had one of the best hot meals in any airline in a long time. Hope to fly with them again one day
reviews.author: benjoman0

reviews.title: Nice lounge in Nauru
reviews.text: Flight was actually in business but it will only show economy as an option. Was actually flying Tarawa-Nauru-Brisbane. Efficient connection. I was pleasantly surprised at how nice the airport was in Nauru (particularly after flying out of the under construction airport in Tarawa). The Biz Class lounge in Nauru isn't fancy but the Internet is decent and there is a good selection of snacks/drinks. Staff are very friendly and helpful.
reviews.author: TristanEF

reviews.title: Turn back
reviews.text: Flight via Air Vanuatu Bris to Santo. Flight turned back half way,, poor excuses, no honest explanations at Bris, no voucher for dinner pre night flight number 2, eventually got in around 11pm, not 4 pm.... bye.....
reviews.author: Trevor C

reviews.title: Bad Experience
reviews.text: We were 30mins late departing and 2 hours into the flight they said there was an issue with the auto pilot function and couldn’t land in Vanuatu so turned around back to Brisbane. We waiting in Brisbane for 5 hours before they got us another plane, they gave us no food vouchers and did not serve us dinner on the second flight attempt, I was starving! We finally landed at midnight instead of 4pm. On the way back they were 30mins late again. Staff were friendly and meals where good when we got them.
reviews.author: Zimalia

reviews.title: Bottom of the pack
reviews.text: This direct service from Vila to Brisbane would be the only reason to fly on this aircraft. Air Vanuatu current code shares this service for direct Brisbane flights - however this will change mid 2019 with the introduction of a new fleet of Air Vanuatu Bombardier aircraft. A very tired uncomfortable cabin, seats past their useful life and no inflight entertainment (at all). Cabin service by the crew was excellent, but the food and beverage service was budget.
reviews.author: Peter K

reviews.title: Late service but good flight.
reviews.text: Flew in the 737, old aircraft but well maintained interior with the original seating - which means plenty of leg room (puts new aircraft to shame!) Flight was delayed by an hour waiting for the aircraft to arrive. Slow turn around once it did. Comfortable flight. Good food and gave seconds if requested. Excellent drinks service, servicing the cabin twice in 2.75 h flight. Great service. If it ran on time would recommend however local people reported it was usually late.
reviews.author: Catherine H

reviews.title: Water water where is the water
reviews.text: It took over an hour for service trolley to get to us in seat 16 and when it did they kept going to reload. On return flight.got water after clearing customs to take on board and informed at board gate can’t take water on to plane. I relinquished mine & kept waiting another 30 minutes for water never heard a no water request before after going thru security checks. They get 1 star for remembering my gf both ways Will be flying Air Fuji next visit
reviews.author: jackiedd50

reviews.title: Small but good Airline
reviews.text: Nauru Airlines is a very small airline but their service is good. Basically an island hopping airline, they kept to their schedule and the flight was comfortable.
reviews.author: Gyan Fernando

reviews.title: Flight was satisfactory.
reviews.text: This is nothing fancy but it is the best way to get from Nadi to Nauru, Kiribati or Marshall Islands. You cannot pick your seat and they have the boarding passes printed ahead of time so you can't ask to change it either which was a little frustrating to me as a nervous traveler who likes the aisle seat. However I totally recommend window seat anyways so you can see the islands and atolls as you jump from one country to the next. Both flights were very much on time and service was good on the flight. No movies or tvs on the seat so make sure to bring books, music, or movies on your laptop. Overall was fine and the food was okay.
reviews.author: Jamie B

reviews.title: Average is already too good
reviews.text: Delayed as usual, one hour this time, fourth time I have to fly on Nauru Airlines , after having booked for Air Vanuatu, and one more time disappointed by service on board, these people used to hired by Australian government to fly refugees to Nauru, but have no idea what is service on international flights. Staff is helpful but have no idea of what is good service, meals served with no drinks, hard to get one after 3 calls, plane really oldish... Honestly Air Vanuatu needs to stop hiring this airline, or at least tell us when we book our flight. Service and staff are so good on Air Vanuatu, what a difference !!!
reviews.author: jmbsmb

reviews.title: Everything ok
reviews.text: Our flight from Port Vila to Brisbane was operated by Nauru airlines (flight sold by Qantas). The flight departed one hour late, but service was in other respect ok.
reviews.author: 32Morten

reviews.title: Bad Flight
reviews.text: The flight was Average with Ok service and Ok Seats. But the Toilets were disgusting and the Plane was not very clean but Overall was a bit Expensive. And the Plane was operating as Norfolk Island Airlines
reviews.author: Logan C

reviews.title: Good service
reviews.text: Flight was delayed for 3 hours, but service was good, friendly stuff, food is quite basic. You can have alcohol to your meal. No entertainment on-board. Very expensive!
reviews.author: sash712018

reviews.title: Better than reviews suggested but it was budget flying
reviews.text: Due to adverse reviews and the history of Nauru Airlines on airline websites we paid a little extra by booking through Qantas instead of Air Vanuatu who utilise Nauru for direct flights to Santo.. We thought that would cover cancellations etc a little better than the actual carrier. Our return flight was delayed for hours but that was due to one of the nearby volcanoes getting over active. Yes the aircraft is an older 737 but we believe registration etc is now handled through Australia so that did not bother us. The flight was very smooth and there were no issues that we were aware of. I'm tall and had plenty of legroom. I prefer cold cabins when flying but actually put a blanket over myself for this flight, it was really cold. My seat squab was loose and needed attention too. The cabin crew were wonderful although they need a refresher on way they describe the meal selections - my wife's spaghetti and lamb was actually an Asian lamb with noodles and Asian greens, my beef and mash (sic) was a rich beef casserole with vegetables. The entrée was a serving of pesto prawns on rice that didn't look too good but tasted delicious.Both main meals were really enjoyable!! Beverages were available and we noted that spirit servings were very generous, a little ice and then top up the glass. Would fly with Nauru again.
reviews.author: Stephen W

reviews.title: Hard to review
reviews.text: Firstly, these guys are doing their work on behalf of Air Vanuatu, which I suppose we should be thankful to get there at all and should really be annoyed at the airline we booked with. Service was curt at times and impolite, however I think the crew were mostly trying their best, it just wasnt that good. Being an hour late to take off to paradise is never a good start. being told to wait for the next drink service when you want water is worse..no entertainment on board, poor in this day and age...food was great which was a nice surprise and we arrived in one piece....so overall I would avoid using them again, but not totally unhappy.
reviews.author: Peter S

reviews.title: Useless unreliable incompetent fourth-world airline - avoid
reviews.text: They cancelled the flight out from under me, only one flight a week mind, moved it to the day before. Screwed up my entire vacation. Thanks for nothing.
reviews.author: JGPH

reviews.title: Make the best of what they have
reviews.text: Its an aged 737 fleet and there is no entertainment on board but the food was surprisingly good.Unfortunately you cannot select your seat which is an issue on a 4 hour + flight...I have had worst flights with much bigger airlines.
reviews.author: marcopirro

reviews.title: Completely impressed
reviews.text: Booking Nauru Airlines was a bit of an adventure, I thought at the beginning. I needed to get from Fiji to Pohnpei - and they happened to provide just the flight. I didn't expect anything really - and was in for a super positive surprise. Good pilots, even during turbulence they managed to make the passengers feel safe (Fiji - Nauru, horrible turbulence). There are lots of drinks and food and snacks. The staff is amazing, really: friendly, caring, you are actually an individual person to them, in a plane full of economy passengers. Special thanks to Anisa, Lisa-Maree and Chris. You rock! When I stayed at the same hotel as the cabin crew did, and my Air Niugini flight was cancelled, they did not hesitate a moment to help me get a new flight to leave Pohnpei, although they weren't on duty at all. Many thanks to the Nauru-Pohnpei-cabin-crew! Planes were on time, transit in Nauru was a breeze, food and drinks were nice, the cabin crew is exceptional.
reviews.author: Dan8319

reviews.title: Once again disappointing
reviews.text: This is an actual Solomon Airline flight but operated by Nauru Airlines. This is my third time on this airline and route. Luckily I was in row 8 for one flight but this time row 21 of 22. The last 4 or 5 rows only get one choice of meal because they do not cater for the amount of people on board. The staff are extremely slow. They should do work experience with qantas or virgin on the Sydney - Melbourne route where you get a meal out and in in less than an hour. The staff on board this aircraft took over 1.5 hours to get the meal served and a drink to the poor squashed passengers. There is no inflight entertainment not even an app based program. I will where I can not fly with them again but I am sometimes forced to (kicking and screaming).
reviews.author: Patrick S

reviews.title: A bit tight
reviews.text: Currently Nauru Airlines are flying for Solomon airlines while their plane is in for service. Nauru Airlines is a older plane with tighter room. The overhead locker fill up very quickly so get on the plane first or you will miss out on space. They had 2 choices of meal on the plane and ran out of one by the time they got to the last 6 rows of the full plane. Short flight and the service was average. There is no in flight entertainment on this flight or the Solomon Airlines flight. I normally fly this route on a Tuesday or Thursday so I can get the Virgin plane out of Brisbane.
reviews.author: Patrick S

reviews.title: Extremely recommendable flight
reviews.text: I strongly recommend Nauru airlines. Our flight from Pohnpei to Nauru and continuing to the Solomon islands was impeccable. First a breakfast was served between Pohnpei and Majuro and subsequently after each stopover (Majuro and Tarawa) an extensive snack was served. Staff is ver friendly and helpful. The flight is punctual. It is also the only flight which connects the northern pacific with the southern pacific. Well done!!
reviews.author: dirk d

reviews.title: Excellent airline - recommend it very strongly
reviews.text: As frequent travellers it is quiet unusual to encounter surprises when flying with new airlines. Well, Nauru airlines is one of these. Leaving Pohnpei with a handful of people in the very early morning hours you wouldn’t expect a lot of activity in the service. Wrong again you get a full breakfast rarely seen before. Then each time between stopovers in Majuro, Tarawa and Nauru you get a large snack. The staff is very hepful and friendly. The views on this scenic flight are wonderful and a must for flight freeks. Flights are punctual.
reviews.author: Dirk D

reviews.title: Return flight Brisbane to Norfolk Island
reviews.text: We were well looked after on both flights. My husband fractured his tibia on Norfolk Island and required wheel chair assisted boarding by forklift onto the plane and assisted departure from the plane in Brisbane. We wish to thank both airports and Nauru Airlines for the care and support my husband and myself were provided. We would definitely fly with them again.
reviews.author: 958fran2015

reviews.title: Friendly service!
reviews.text: Nice to experience friendly stewards on board as opposed to those who think they are doing you a favor by serving you..... It was a very smooth flight. No complaints at all!
reviews.author: Sue F

reviews.title: Perfect flight
reviews.text: The flight was just perfect. Landed on time and the airline staff together with the ground staff were friendly and competent. Being only a couple of hours there was no entertainment on board.We had morning tea offered.
reviews.author: 645Laurel

reviews.title: Delays but friendly service
reviews.text: My original flight was cancelled and I ended up on the next flight. As with most Pacific Island travel check-in and other processing was slow and they could (and Nauru authorities) do much better. In the air the service is friendly and efficient. Meals are good. Nice sandwiches and then good hot meal. Complementary drinks, beer wine etc. Planes former Air NZ in pretty good condition and reasonablably comfortable. Huge room in exit row.
reviews.author: Lachlan C

reviews.title: Flight to an Island Jewel
reviews.text: Top experience. Fantastic cabin crew - smiling, attentive, thoughtful and funny. Small jet - only seats 130 passengers = comfort to me! Lots of legroom/no toilet queues! Short (just over 2 hour) flight but excellent food service. Complimentary wine was enjoyed by my friend. Great snack food - cheese'n'crackers and mighty muffinsI It was a smooth flight and great start to an island in the 'paradise' class!
reviews.author: Pierette1

reviews.title: Worst airline in the Pacific
reviews.text: Have flown with these guys for work several times. They have never ever been on time yet, long delays checking in, flight always delayed, and we are not talking 30 minutes, usually hours, sometimes by days. A complete and utter shambles!! I am very suspicious of the previous positive reviews!!!
reviews.author: jack b

reviews.title: horrible check in, pleasant flight
reviews.text: The start of the flight in Brisbane was pathetic, a woman of about 60 at check in denied boarding to several passengers due to lack of visa, when my turn came, without letting me speak and in very bad ways, she said no he could travel since he did not have visa for nauru, although it only flew in transit towards the islands Marshall. to my repeated complaints sent me to the person in charge of Nauru airlines, that also with a very improved forms and education commented to me that if it could travel, although it believed that not to the Marshall islands; after a long and stressful check, found that with the European Union passport he could travel to the marshall islands without a visa. A disaster of check in. the flight itself was pleasant, Boeing 737-200, quite old, good space between the legs, almost full flight in the first stage. Route: Brisbane / honiara / nauru / majuro / tarawa. price: 680 euros the whole route. food. nice, Crew: friendly, no more.
reviews.author: agusticassa

reviews.title: great flight
reviews.text: No on board console but the crew makes up for any deficiency, very courteous and friendly always smiling and making you feel welcome
reviews.author: 835cdj

reviews.title: Nauru Airlines
reviews.text: Air Nauru is a relatively unknown carrier. The food is good, considering it is airline food. Seats are comfortable. There is no in flight entertainment, so bring a book.
reviews.author: Kai_Steinbeck

reviews.title: Excellent service and on-board catering to put many larger airlines to shame
reviews.text: We joined the Nauru Airlines flight at Brisbane on our way to Tarawa. This was like an island hopping bus trip, taking in Honiara and Nauru before arriving at Tarawa. Compared with getting to Tarawa via though Fiji, these guys were excellent value for money. They fly into Central Pacific areas where few other airlines go, providing connectivity that extends from Nadi to the Marshall islands, hubbing though Nauru and into Brisbane. The aircraft are earlier model B737's, so that lack on-board entertainment, however the superb cabin service we experienced made up for that. Nauru Airlines economy class meals have to be seen to be believed - they could show many larger airlines what airline catering is all about. Plentiful in quantity, excellent in taste and topped up with a great drinks service and very friendly cabin staff. I was very impressed with this airline. Couldn't say the same about Bonriki Airport which appears to be clearly lacking in aircraft handling facilities an clean toilets. But hey, if you travel in these regions much you have to expect this.
reviews.author: Alaroy01

reviews.title: You won't have a choice
reviews.text: Have flown few times work work. This is the only airline available to fly in and out Nauru. Staff are good and friendly. Food is reasonable. Seats are worst than a budget airline. Definitely not suits for an international airline. There is no in flight entertainment. Make sure to pack a good book to read or have your Pc/Tablet charged if you want to watch something. There is no power available on board. Expect for a long wait at the airport after landing as they do not have electronic processing. All done manually.
reviews.author: Manoj D

reviews.title: Travel duty on Nauru Airlines
reviews.text: My travels on Nauru Airlines was spectacular. The airport staff were very accommodating; the flight attendants were friendly and professional. The Pilot and his crew were dexterous. Their services were awesome. Food and drinks were appropriate and though the travel was long, it was worth it! However, there was no movie---;)
reviews.author: Patti P
